coordinate_system: Godot world metres; Y up; Z rows strictly increasing

generated_from.method: Read actual GLB triangles transformed by full node hierarchy. Union nondegenerate triangles with all vertices abs(Y)<1e-6, excluding Foliage/Moss/BarkPlates exactly as CrownArena collision. Translate to existing arena placements; intersect with the piecewise bank-height<0 corridor. Preserve every disconnected component and hole; constrained Delaunay triangulation; no convex hull or AABB substitution. Clip water with exactly the same foundation union. Nine decimal metre storage. Recompute after source GLB or profile change.

limitations: Minimum width applies to the two main bank profiles, not navigable space after existing north pillars.
Only underwater exposed Y0 bottom faces are extended; original mesh openings/holes and high geometry are untouched.
Roots that overhang above the actual Y0 plane are not inventively filled.
Water geometry is visual; make_shape(water) must return null. Physical riverbed is Y=-3.2.
Ground shaders and world environmental water queries must be wired to these same profiles/footprints by root; this module does not modify them.
All current optical, task, traversal and boss regressions must be rerun after integration. No artwork, physical flight or GPU acceptance is implied.
South gate foundation is a separate exact graybox polygon from f1_growth_crossing.json, extending bed to shutter contact Y2.9; approach solids remain outside the water.
